visual_copy_on_image: She has no partner to negotiate with. The roster still works.
A single mother built a night system for one. The baby sleeps better. She sleeps better. The roster did not require a second adult — it required a plan.

post_copy.hook_text: A roster does not require a partner. It requires a named shift and a named person to cover it — a support web, not a marriage contract. The night still needs an owner and a schedule.
post_copy.problem_text: Nobody owns the night, so the default becomes she owns all of it. Doing 100% of nights, every night, for weeks — with no partner shift to hand off to.
post_copy.bold_line: Schedules a support-web roster — named shifts for family, friends, or paid help — so the mother's protected block is physically real. A sleep banker makes exhaustion visible and tradeable even without a partner.
